title: Letting someone go: the process, the person and the team the next morning

videos.script: The plan has ended, and the decision is made. Marcos's employment at Caju will end. {{title}} Most of what happens next is not Renata's to improvise. The law, the people team and the company's process decide the terms. {{process}} Her part is the conversation. It is short. The decision comes in the first minute, and it is not a debate. {{conversation}} Then the team. An empty desk tomorrow, and a silence people will fill with the worst explanation they can find. {{team}} This lesson is about all three. And about what to say when somebody asks why, and what to say when nobody asks, but everybody wonders whether they are next. {{next}}
